title: FluentAI Vocabulary Item Schema
description: Schema for offline-first CEFR-graded vocabulary content tailored for Turkish professional learners.

id.description: Stable semantic content identifier, e.g. vocab.deliberation or vocab.articulate-v

headword.description: The lexical item or headword in English, e.g. deliberation

cefr_level.description: CEFR level from A2 to C2

part_of_speech.description: Grammatical category of the lexical item

audio_ref.description: Relative path to pre-generated audio asset, e.g. audio/vocab/deliberation.mp3

definition_en.description: Clear English-first definition calibrated to the target CEFR level

meaning_tr.description: Turkish reveal translation/gloss, displayed on demand (ADR-009)

collocations.description: High-frequency professional and natural English collocations

text.description: Collocation phrase in English, e.g. after much deliberation

tr.description: Optional Turkish translation of the collocation

note.description: Optional usage note or context hint

examples.description: Contextual example sentences with Turkish translations

en.description: Natural English sentence showing the word in context

tr.description: Accurate Turkish translation of the example sentence

context.description: Domain context, e.g. Executive Meeting, Technical Design, Negotiations

turkish_traps.description: Specific transfer pitfalls, false friends, and preposition traps for Turkish speakers (ADR-010)

trap_type.description: Category of Turkish L1 negative transfer trap

trap_note_tr.description: Explanation in Turkish of the common error Turkish learners make and why

incorrect_example.description: Example of the typical Turkish learner error

topic_tags.description: Domain and thematic tags for curriculum navigation and Today's Practice orchestration

related_ids.description: Semantic IDs of related vocabulary, grammar, or scenario content

version.description: Schema version of this content entry
